newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts Storage Dimensions.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts Storage Dimensions.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Storage Dimensions Inc to buy from strong buy.

-- Storage Dimensions Inc said Thursday it expects second quarter results to fall below its earlier expectations, because of near-term softness in the PC-LAN market, price erosion on disk drive components, below plan staffing of its end-user sales force and product introduction expenses.
-- Salomon said now expects Storage Dimensions to post a second quarter loss of $0.07 a share from an earlier estimate of $0.17 a share.
-- said trimmed the third quarter estimate to $0.10 a share from $0.22 a share and cut the fourth quarter estimate to $0.27 a share from $0.28 a share.
-- said believes "most of the shift in the second quarter was due to external factors beyond the company's control."
